name: landingSpeed
meaning: the rider's landing speed as seesaw_AddBody records it (0 when resting, at least 512 when landing, 48000 for an armed ejection); weights the rider's torque in seesaw_Update

name: canLaunch
meaning: 0 when the rider stood in an ejection box's side (the landing arms that box instead); a later, faster landing only raises landingSpeed when this is set
